name: PMAY (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana)
summary: Financial assistance and interest subsidy for construction or purchase of a house, aimed at achieving 'Housing for All'.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant or any family member must not own a pucca (permanent) house anywhere in India.
Applicant must belong to Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), or Middle Income Group (MIG) as defined by annual household income.
EWS: annual household income up to Rs. 3,00,000.
LIG: annual household income between Rs. 3,00,001 and Rs. 6,00,000.
MIG-I: annual household income between Rs. 6,00,001 and Rs. 12,00,000.
MIG-II: annual household income between Rs. 12,00,001 and Rs. 18,00,000.
Preference given to women as owner/co-owner, persons with disabilities, senior citizens, SC/ST/OBC, and minorities.
Applicant family should not have availed benefits under any other housing scheme from the Government of India.
required_documents: Proof of no existing pucca house (self-declaration/affidavit)
Caste certificate (if applicable, for priority category)
benefit_amount: Interest subsidy up to Rs. 2.67 lakh depending on income category, or direct assistance for rural beneficiaries
